checks: immutable prepared request pins deployed contracts, chain, exact amounts and scoped access
provider account/network changes, declined consent and arbitrary schemas cannot submit approval
server verifies exact signer and domain, delegates to agreement service and retains one approval across retries
two fixture-wallet approvals produce the canonical approved agreement without funding or sending a transaction
existing identity service verifies and consumes a session-bound fixture wallet challenge once
funded or expired agreements and changed escrow context cannot create a signing handoff or approval
scope: Actual isolated PostgreSQL with local fixture signatures and a scripted EIP-1193 provider; no public RPC call, transaction, human approval or Brave signing performed.
